lines.text: Midnight. Three agents are working through your backlog while you are fast asleep.
Then each one hits a question that only you can answer.
Without a board, those questions sit silently in three different terminals, and nobody ever sees them.
So all three agents sit idle all night, and your backlog barely moves.
In Agent R Q, every question lands on one board, in order, with the full context attached.
Each card carries who asked, what they asked, and why, so you never have to guess.
You wake up, grab your phone, and open the board over coffee.
Answer the question, allow the command, deny the risky one. All of it takes two minutes.
The agents pick up your replies instantly, and carry on with the work.
Three answers, two minutes, and the whole queue is cleared before breakfast.
Instead of idling all night, the agents lost minutes, not hours.
That is how a backlog gets finished while the humans are still asleep.
What was the longest an agent ever waited on you overnight? Tell us below, or try it at Agent R Q dot com.
